1. Check the file against the size limit. Paid plans accept files up to 250 MB; the Free plan accepts files up to 50 MB.

These steps come from our guide "File uploads fail or stop partway" (KB-105). If they don't solve the problem, reply here and tell us what you see.

1. Update to the latest version. Choose Help → Check for updates and restart the app after installing.

1. Update to the latest version. Versions before 4.6.0 have a known start-up crash that updating fixes. Download the latest installer from quillstack.example/download.
2. Restart the computer. This clears locked files left behind by an earlier crash.

4. Reinstall the app. Uninstall Quillstack, then install the latest version again.
